subject: communal-quirks
q: How many household quirks are still unfiled?
detail: Fifteen went in on 6 September. The Ghost Haven appendix carries more that have not been broken out into their own records — the Kitchen Threshold Marks, the Garage Stain, the Gravity Couch, the Cuddle Couch, the Moon Window, the First Morning Ritual, the Bolted Bookcases, the Attic Loft. The pattern of this family is that new ones form continuously and get named afterward, so this question does not close; it gets re-answered.
